symptom: ako/mxcli#876 review of PR #892: `check -p` reported an MDL-V1-REBUILD error ("exec would refuse this statement") for `drop module M; create or modify microflow M.F …` under mdl 1, while exec dropped the module and created the flow cleanly. Same false error after `move folder M.Folder to OtherModule;` (the folder's flows leave the module).
cause: CheckFlowVerdicts' 'an earlier statement touched this flow' guard listed create/alter/drop/move/rename of the flow and rename of its module, but not the statements that remove or relocate a flow wholesale: drop module and move folder. A document move to another module also left the flow's new name unguarded.
fix: DropModuleStmt marks its module touched; MoveFolderStmt marks the source and target modules touched (which flows move is the project's to say); MoveStmt with a TargetModule also marks the moved name.
test: mdl/roundtrip/flow_verdict_agreement_test.go TestFlowVerdictAgreement_EarlierStatementIsNotPredicted: drop-module and move-folder cases; fail without the fix ('a create after dropping its module was predicted as a refused modify'). Verified on a TestApp copy: check errored, exec 'Dropped module … Created microflow'.
insight: A 'the script changed this state first' guard is a list of every statement that changes it, including the coarse ones that act on a container (module, folder) rather than the document; enumerate statements by what they remove, not by what they name.
